replies.author: RCMP_Mountie
replies.body:
Sorry, but this is insufficient evidence to warrant a punishment against the player. We cannot punish cross teamers based solely on the chat. Please provide more evidence in the form of multiple screenshots or a video in future reports.

Thank you for your concern though, and keep up the reports!
